Revised Edition of the Laws Act
(Chapter 275, Sections 11(3))
Order under Section 11(3)
O 25
G.N. No. S 640/2001
REVISED EDITION 2002
(31st January 2002)
[31st December 2001]
Whereas pursuant to section 10 of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act, the Law Revision Commissioners have published in loose-leaf form the Acts set out in the Schedule as in force on 30th November 2001:
And Whereas it is provided under section 11(3) of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act that the Commissioners shall transmit to the President a copy of each of the loose-leaf edition of these Acts and the President may thereupon, by order published in the Gazette, specify that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, in all courts and for all purposes, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts:
Now therefore it is hereby ordered by the President that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, with effect from 31st December 2001, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts.

THE SCHEDULE
1. Accountants Act (Chapter 2)
2. Agri-food and Veterinary Authority Act (Chapter 5)
3. Carriage by Air Act (Chapter 32A)
4. Central Provident Fund Act (Chapter 36)
5. Chemical Weapons (Prohibition) Act (Chapter 37B)
6. Children and Young Persons Act (Chapter 38)
7. Compulsory Education Act (Chapter 51)
8. Defence Science and Technology Agency Act (Chapter 75A)
9. Developmental Investment Fund Act (Chapter 79)
10. Enlistment Act (Chapter 93)
11. Income Tax Act (Chapter 134)
12. Legal Profession Act (Chapter 161)
13. Medical and Elderly Care Endowment Schemes Act (Chapter 173A)
14. Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act (Chapter 190A)
15. Oaths and Declarations Act (Chapter 211)
16. Political Donations Act (Chapter 236)
17. Registered Designs Act (Chapter 266)
18. Sewerage and Drainage Act (Chapter 294)
19. Singapore Management University Act (Chapter 302A)
20. Traditional Chinese Medicine Practitioners Act (Chapter 333A).
[G.N. No. S 640/2001]
